snippet_primary:
> "Your customer will be charged: $10 + (0.20 × $10) = $12"

> "We will charge 5% and will collect the EU VAT amount: (0.05 × $10) + (0.20 × $10) = $2.50"

> "You will receive the remaining amount: $12 – $2.50 = $9.50 (Note: PayPal will deduct it's fees as well)"
subject_exact: Payhip help center (help.payhip.com/article/127-digital-eu-vat, Feb 21, 2026) provides EU VAT calculation examples for a $10 product at 20% EU VAT: VAT-excluded pricing (customer pays $12, Payhip takes $2.50 = 5% fee + VAT, seller receives $9.50 before PayPal fees); VAT-included pricing (customer pays $10, pre-VAT price $8.33, Payhip takes $2.09, seller receives $7.91 before PayPal fees)
metric_value_raw: VAT-excl: $10 + 20% → customer $12, Payhip $2.50, seller $9.50; VAT-incl: $10 → Payhip $2.09, seller $7.91
local_qualifiers: EU VAT examples at Free plan (5% fee + 20% VAT): VAT-excl seller gets $9.50 of $12; VAT-incl seller gets $7.91 of $10
parser_notes: help.payhip.com (Feb 21, 2026). EU VAT examples: $10 + 20% VAT; excl pricing: seller $9.50/12; incl pricing: seller $7.91/10; Free plan.
